steps.speaker: Frantic Woman
steps.content: Haha... I'm on my way home... almost home... but you're in my way again... the FAC is in my way again... haha...
A maniacal figure stood in your way out.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: A Sinner?! Be careful everyone! The most dangerous enemy is approaching!

steps.speaker: Frantic Woman
steps.content: Since you came already, then let's chop you up together and take it home as a gift! Hahahaha!

steps.speaker: Fleeing Archer
steps.content: Hahaha, if you can't beat a little chainsaw maniac, then your time is over...

steps.speaker: Fleeing Archer
steps.content: Hey! MBCC trash! The Archer Queen of Syndicate is here! Get out of my way or eat my arrow!
Despite their best efforts to protect you, the guards were beaten back time and again.

steps.speaker: Guard Captain
steps.content: Sinners are hard to hold off! We won't last long! Adjutant Nightingale, please act quickly!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Understood! The Bureau will never forget your sacrifices!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Force field recharge complete, activating shield function! Don't even think about going near him, you maniac!
steps.female_content: Force field recharge complete, activating shield function! Don't even think about going near her, you maniac!

steps.content: The shield was activated, keeping out all the pursuers.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Can you move, Chief? Quick, get out of here! That Sinner can trigger EMP and will destroy this kind of trap in no time.

steps.speaker: Guard Captain
steps.content: Adjutant Nightingale, take Chief away. You've got me here!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Thanks!
She turned around and pulled you into the secret passage. The surviving guards let out a final roar behind you, which is soon swallowed up by thugs' maniacal laughter.

steps.speaker: Rioter
steps.content: Die! Die! The world doesn't need jails!
She dragged you out of the secret passage and pressed a hidden button on the side. The wall opens, and an elevator door appears. The light indicates that it's approaching.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Please get in, Chief. The elevator will take you to the hidden mezzanine. You will be safe staying there. Don't leave until our backup arrives.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: What about you?|You're coming with me.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I'll divert them.
Nightingale reloads her guns. The shouts of the approaching pursuers grow near. Her eyes and guns are trained ahead while the wound on her forehead continues to bleed.
The bright red irritates your nerves and pokes at the unknown corners of your fractured memories.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Don't hesitate, Chief. Your life is the most valuable, more so than everyone else here.
The enemies are here to kill you, and the persons in front of you may die to save you. They all call you Chief and say your life is valuable.
If you really are that valuable, then...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: There must be something I can do.

steps.speaker: Rioter
steps.content: Look at his dumb face. I bet he's still just a loser.
steps.female_content: Look at her dumb face. I bet she's still just a loser.

steps.speaker: Rioter
steps.content: Kill him! We can only be truly free if that man is dead!
steps.female_content: Kill her! We can only be truly free if that woman is dead!

steps.content: You vaguely sense that these desires to kill you mask their fear of you. The prisoners fear something that has not yet awakened in you. You have the potential power to suppress them.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...You want to fight like this?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No way! You've only just woken up from the disrupted repair program. You're still very weak, and your memory is...

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: These are my order and responsibility as the Chief.|Then I'll let you be my guide.
options: This is the decision I make as the "Chief."
Then I'll let you be my guide

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I've crossed the line. Chief, you're stronger than we think.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Copy that. Since you've chosen to fight, it's my duty to assist you as your adjutant.
She changed the command on the elevator, which changes the destination floor, and a red warning light suddenly flashes on the screen.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Bureau can no longer hold on until the reinforcements arrive. There's only one way to bring an end to this crisis.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, a forbidden power lies dormant in the depth of this jail. It's more dangerous and powerful than our enemies.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That's <color=#fb9259>your power</color>. Awaken it. I'm sure you can control it.
Ding! The elevator doors open while rioters appear from around the corner. Before their bullets reach you, Nightingale pushes you into the elevator.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: I will come back to save you.|Hold on. Don't die.
options: I will come back to save you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Go ahead, ${PlayerName}.
